reports.title: Remitly Reports Record Third Quarter Results and Raises Full Year 2026 Outlook

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: For fiscal year 2026, Remitly currently expects:
•Total revenue in the range of $1.989 billion to $1.991 billion, representing a growth rate of 22% year over year.
•Year over year growth in net income, and Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $441 million to $443 million.
